# Bundled LTX-2 code

`ltx_core/` and `ltx_pipelines/` are copied unmodified from
https://github.com/Lightricks/LTX-2 at commit `e98f6d9`
(`packages/ltx-core/src/ltx_core` and `packages/ltx-pipelines/src/ltx_pipelines`).
The pipeline depends on the API of this exact version; later LTX-2 releases
changed it.

This code, and the LTX-2.5 weights it loads, are licensed under the LTX
Community License Agreements in this folder (`LICENSE`, `LICENSE-2`,
`LICENSE-2_x`). Use is subject to the use-based restrictions in Section 4 and
Attachment A of `LICENSE-2_x`, in their entirety, including all use
restrictions and acceptable use policies.
